candidates.why_considered: Fire control, guidance, and related equipment category could be implicated if the payload-interface module integrates guidance-related sensor or inertial equipment, a possibility left open by the unresolved facts on controlled sensors/inertial items.

Military electronics category covers specially designed electronic equipment for military systems; a payload-interface/flight-control module could be viewed as controlled electronic equipment if incorporating controlled sensors, encryption, or inertial items, which is unresolved here.

Item is described as an unmanned-aircraft flight-control and payload-interface module; USML VIII(a) covers unmanned aircraft and related articles, so a control module for a UAS is a plausible enumerated or SD match if the host aircraft/mission were military.

USML VIII(h) catalogs specially designed components, parts, and accessories for military aircraft, including flight control systems; a flight-control module could fall here if specially designed for a defense article, though development history/military nexus is unknown.
The residual is seated on every board; it is elected only when every specific candidate is knocked out.
